title: At the check-in desk
instructions: Bay Demir havalimanında check-in yapıyor. Bagaj, koltuk ve kapı bilgilerini takip et.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Good morning. Where are you flying to today?

script.speaker: demir
script.text: To Berlin. Here is my passport.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Thank you. How many bags are you checking in?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Please put it on the scale. It's twenty-four kilos. The limit is twenty-three.

script.speaker: demir
script.text: Oh no. Can I take something out?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, or you can pay forty euros.

script.speaker: demir
script.text: I'll take my shoes out and put them in my small bag.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: OK, now it's twenty-two kilos. Would you like a window or an aisle seat?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Here is your boarding pass. Gate twelve. Boarding starts at ten fifteen.

questions.prompt: How heavy was the suitcase at first?
questions.feedback: Bavul ilk başta yirmi dört kiloydu; limit yirmi üç.

questions.prompt: What does Mr Demir do about the weight?
questions.evidence: I'll take my shoes out and put them in my small bag.
